# Class Project

## Objective
The objective of class project is to teach students the following:    
  
- Collecting data from field (Geometric and Traffic)
- Drawing intersection in CAD 
- Analyzing the Capacity of a roadway intersection

## Tech Memo
The students are expected to complete four (tentative) tech memo with following contents:  

* Tech Memo #1: Assessing the existing geometry of the intersection 
* Tech Memo #2: Assesing the existing traffic of the intersection
* Tech Memo #3: Analyzing the capacity of (LOS) intersection
* Tech Memo #4: Recommendation for improving the intersection
